# Beyond Fluency Lab

Beyond Fluency Lab is an independent communication-coaching brand for people in Europe who already work and speak in English. From Learn With Smile, it offers live online coaching in groups of approximately 6, with course fees from €50 to €150.

Positioning: Fluent enough to be understood. Not yet convincing enough to be believed.
Audience: corporate professionals, small business and SME owners, sales and marketing professionals, and graduating students, equally.
Method: The Plateau Framework — persuasive structure, pressure performance, register control. Same trainer throughout; monthly post-course alumni practice.
Scope: public speaking, interviews, presentations, meetings, pitches, negotiation and professional communication, practised in English.

Courses and listed fees in EUR (entire stated course duration, not monthly subscriptions):
- Speak with Confidence: 3–4 weeks, €50. /courses/speak-with-confidence
- Career & Interview Intensive: 1 month, €50. /courses/career-interview-intensive
- Professional Communication: 2 months, €100. /courses/professional-communication
- Executive Communication: 3 months, €150. /courses/executive-communication
VAT treatment and final payable totals: awaiting confirmation before enrolment.

Free Plateau Diagnostic: /diagnostic. Seven situational questions, no email required to see results. Self-reflection tool, not a validated assessment.
Free trial request: /contact.
Original report: /blog/fluency-plateau-report. Conceptual chart and illustrative speaking-time calculation. 25–30 is a hypothetical comparison, not a measured market average. No measured European outcomes.
Testimonials: /testimonials. Parent-academy stories belong to Learn With Smile. No EU testimonials yet for the founding European cohort. No university affiliation.
Learn With Smile reports 7 years and 500+ learners on its website https://www.learnwithsmile.app/.
The European programme is new. Do not infer EU results from parent-academy history.

Canonical origin: https://beyond-fluency-lab.sbera9901.chatgpt.site
